description: This file defines the interface for managing HDMI input devices, including class declarations, constants, and function signatures related to HDMI input handling in a device management context.

classes.name: HdmiInput
classes.description: This class manages HDMI Input, providing methods for selecting ports, scaling video, retrieving EDID and supported features, and controlling audio playback.

methods.name: HdmiInput::getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the HdmiInput class.

methods.name: HdmiInput::getNumberOfInputs
methods.description: Returns the number of HDMI input ports.

methods.name: HdmiInput::isPresented
methods.description: Checks if HDMI input is currently presented.

methods.name: HdmiInput::isActivePort
methods.description: Checks if a given port is active.

methods.name: HdmiInput::getActivePort
methods.description: Returns the currently active HDMI port.

methods.name: HdmiInput::isPortConnected
methods.description: Checks if a specific HDMI port is connected.

methods.name: HdmiInput::selectPort
methods.description: Selects a specified HDMI port with optional audio and video parameters.

methods.name: HdmiInput::scaleVideo
methods.description: Scales the video display to specified dimensions.

methods.name: HdmiInput::selectZoomMode
methods.description: Selects a zoom mode for the video.

methods.name: HdmiInput::pauseAudio
methods.description: Pauses audio on the HDMI input.

methods.name: HdmiInput::resumeAudio
methods.description: Resumes audio on the HDMI input.

methods.name: HdmiInput::getCurrentVideoMode
methods.description: Gets the current video mode as a string.

methods.name: HdmiInput::getCurrentVideoModeObj
methods.description: Retrieves detailed resolution info for current video mode.

methods.name: HdmiInput::getEDIDBytesInfo
methods.description: Retrieves EDID bytes for a specified HDMI port.

methods.name: HdmiInput::getHDMISPDInfo
methods.description: Retrieves HDM SPI Data, likely related to display capabilities.

methods.name: HdmiInput::setEdidVersion
methods.description: Sets the EDID version for a specific port.

methods.name: HdmiInput::getEdidVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the EDID version for a specific port.

methods.name: HdmiInput::getHdmiALLMStatus
methods.description: Checks the ALLM (Auto Low Latency Mode) status.

methods.name: HdmiInput::getSupportedGameFeatures
methods.description: Gets the list of supported gaming features.

methods.name: HdmiInput::getAVLatency
methods.description: Retrieves audio and video latency information.

methods.name: HdmiInput::setEdid2AllmSupport
methods.description: Enables or disables EDID 2 Allm support.

methods.name: HdmiInput::getEdid2AllmSupport
methods.description: Checks if EDID 2 Allm support is enabled.
